source: Water factors for the illustrative water footprint (Stage 3 T14, D-063): NREL/TP-6A20-50900 (generation water consumption factors) and LBNL-2001637 (data-center site WUE)
license: U.S. Government-sponsored reports (NREL and LBNL, DOE national laboratories), publicly released; values are cited with attribution. See each file's license note.

notes.retrieval: Downloaded with curl on 2026-10-27 (Stage 3 T14). The LBNL landing page (https://eta-publications.lbl.gov/publications/2024-lbnl-data-center-energy-usage-report) links eScholarship (DOI 10.71468/P1WC7Q), which refused scripted downloads (HTTP 403, CloudFront); the same report is served as a PDF on LBL's own publications site, the URL recorded here. Its first page and citation read 'LBNL-2001637', December 2024. The NREL URL answers HEAD with 404 but GET with the PDF.
notes.use: Values transcribed by hand into lab/src/gridpilot/data/water_factors.py (table, page and units next to each), pinned by lab/tests/test_water_factors.py.
notes.location: This manifest is committed with the code (the main checkout's data/manifests/ is a tracked directory: writing an untracked file there would dirty the tree the sealed test entry point checks). The PDFs live in the shared data dir, data/raw/water/ (gitignored), read-only.

files.citation: Macknick, J., Newmark, R., Heath, G., Hallett, K.C. (2011). A Review of Operational Water Consumption and Withdrawal Factors for Electricity Generating Technologies. NREL/TP-6A20-50900, March 2011.
